module: Carry out and maintain the assessment

lesson.title: Prepare for a notified-body assessment
lesson.summary: Prepare quality management, technical assessment and continuing surveillance.

prerequisites.reason: QMS approval needs documented procedures and evidence of the applicable requirements. The assessor needs the system-specific technical file and its evidence.
The application is submitted to the legally qualified assessment body.

blocks: **Quality-management approval** under Annex VII begins with the provider/representative identity, systems covered, each system's technical documentation, Article 17 process documentation, procedures keeping it effective and a declaration that the same application was not lodged elsewhere. The body assesses it and gives a reasoned decision. Approval must be implemented and maintained.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

blocks: Notify intended changes to the approved quality-management system or covered-system list. The body examines them and decides whether the modified system still satisfies the requirements or needs reassessment. A provider cannot silently add a new covered product to an old approval.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

blocks: **Technical-documentation assessment** has a system-specific application: provider identity, declaration about no duplicate application and Annex IV documentation. The body examines the records and may require additional evidence/tests or conduct appropriate tests itself if dissatisfied with the provider's tests.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

blocks: Relevant training, validation and testing dataset access is limited to what is necessary, with appropriate secure remote means where suitable. Access to training/trained models and parameters has stricter conditions: necessity, other reasonable means exhausted and insufficient, a reasoned request, and protection of intellectual property and trade secrets. It is neither automatic unrestricted access nor an absolute secrecy veto.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

blocks: A favourable technical decision produces a certificate identifying the system, provider, conclusions and validity conditions. Non-conformity leads to a reasoned refusal. If the training-data requirement is not met, retraining is needed before applying for a new assessment, with specific reasons about training-data quality.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

blocks: **Quality-management surveillance** checks continuing compliance with the approval. The provider allows access to relevant design/development/testing premises and necessary information. Periodic audits produce reports and may include additional system tests. Approval is an ongoing responsibility, not a one-time purchase.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex VII(1)–(5); Article 17

questions.prompt: A provider wants to add a system to its approved quality-management list. What must it do?

options.blocks: Notify the body for examination and a reasoned decision.
options.reason: Annex VII(3.4) requires assessment of intended changes.

options.blocks: Add it silently because the provider name is unchanged.
options.reason: The covered-system list is part of the approved scope.
